approved_flick.prompt: From the open-palm pose, he curls his right fingers, then sharply flicks his wrist and fingers toward camera-left, like flicking water off his fingertips. Clear preparation, a quick visible snap, and follow-through. Keep his hand raised afterward. Same man and studio. Locked camera. One continuous silent shot.
approved_flick.color_matching: One union cleanup mask prevents color accumulation where bead repairs overlap. Per-channel robust quadratic illumination fit from bead-free neutral wall pixels matches the clean plate to every frame. Wide smoothstep feathers remove warm halos; the patch fades to the native clean wall over the end of the join fade. No global color filter, sharpening or person retouch.
